description: This file contains utility classes and functions related to the Volcengine LLM provider, including a custom exception class, and functions to obtain API base URLs and headers.

classes.name: VolcEngineError
classes.description: A custom exception class for errors specific to the Volcengine provider, inheriting from BaseLLMException.

methods.name: str get_volcengine_base_url(api_base: Optional[str] = None)

methods.description: Constructs and returns headers for API authentication, including optional extra headers.
